_note: WEB-TOUR SFX GRAMMAR — worked example, derived from the measured reference cue map (53s Ruflow-style tour). Laws: a whoosh or pop lands every 2-4s WITHOUT exception; whooshes sit in VO edit-gaps (transitions), pops land ON content (highlights); ONE stop-and-slam at ~85% runtime (140ms duck then the loudest hit of the video); keys only under a terminal beat. Copy this file to films/<ep>.manifest.json, re-anchor to your episode's beats, and delete these _note rows or leave them (the mixer skips any event carrying _note).
_beats: Assumed ~34s skeleton: beat0 cold-open 0-1.6 (HeroDrop) · beat1 claim 1.6-6 (SerifCap + first punch) · beat2 tour 6-14 (scroll/focus/selections) · beat3 VsTable 14-20 · beat4 TermRun 20-26 · beat5 payoff 26-30 · beat6 outro 30-34. @beatN resolves against the MEASURED props clock, so these offsets survive VO_SPEED changes.
_levels: sfx_mix --gain_db -9 (default) is the whole layer's ride under the -14 LUFS VO spine. Per-event gain_db is an OFFSET vs kit level (default 0); the mix is peak-normalized to the loudest event, which must stay the slam.

film._duck_note: the 140ms dead-stop: video audio (VO+bed) drops to 0.06x, window ENDS exactly on the slam (reference 45.65-45.79s -> slam 45.8). Also settable per-run via sfx_mix --duck 't0,t1'.
